sn46.16:1.1: On one occasion the Blessed One was dwelling at Rajagaha in the Bamboo Grove, the Squirrel Sanctuary.
sn46.16:1.2: Now on that occasion the Blessed One was sick, afflicted, gravely ill.
sn46.16:1.3: Then the Venerable Mahacunda approached the Blessed One, paid homage to him, and sat down to one side. The Blessed One then said to the Venerable Mahacunda:
sn46.16:2.1: “These seven factors of enlightenment, venerable sir, have been rightly expounded by the Blessed One; when developed and cultivated, they lead to direct knowledge, to enlightenment, to Nibbāna.
sn46.16:2.3: The enlightenment factor of mindfulness has been rightly expounded by the Blessed One;
sn46.16:2.4: when developed and cultivated, it leads to direct knowledge, to enlightenment, to Nibbāna…. The enlightenment factor of equanimity has been rightly expounded by the Blessed One; when developed and cultivated, it leads to direct knowledge, to enlightenment, to Nibbāna. These seven factors of enlightenment, venerable sir, have been rightly expounded by the Blessed One; when developed and cultivated, they lead to direct knowledge, to enlightenment, to Nibbāna.”
sn46.16:2.5: “Surely, Cunda, they are factors of enlightenment!
sn46.16:2.6: Surely, Cunda, they are factors of enlightenment!”
sn46.16:3.1: This is what the Venerable Mahacunda said.
sn46.16:3.3: And the Blessed One recovered from that illness. In such a way the Blessed One was cured of his illness.
